$comment: The expo-updates fingerprints of the binaries currently in users' hands.
An `eas update` only reaches a build whose fingerprint matches exactly;
publishing to any other value reports success and reaches zero devices,
with no error anywhere. scripts/verify-ota-target.mjs compares the working
tree against this file and refuses to publish on a mismatch.
Update this file in the same commit that ships a new binary, and never to
silence the preflight — a mismatch means the update cannot land, not that
"setAside" lists files that landed on main after that binary was built and
only touch another platform's native code. scripts/publish-ota.mjs removes
them from its throwaway tree before fingerprinting that platform, so JS from
main still reaches the binary. Drop the list when that platform ships a new
binary. This file is not a fingerprint input, so editing it never moves one.

android.$note: Built from main f6e882a2 (EAS build 8ff7fbda, workflow run 35983639391) and submitted to the Play closed alpha 2026-09-24 (EAS submission 63d629df). First binary with light mode (#202: userInterfaceStyle automatic, per-platform splash with a dark variant, expo-navigation-bar) and the fourth expo-video patch, which is iOS-only but moves this fingerprint too because patches/ is hashed whole. The fingerprint equals a clean npm ci of f6e882a2, computed before the build. Play production still runs 0.1.5 (73) at 2d4421b05ba6a84852602d69de16770822f79daf until 0.1.6 is promoted, and no update from main can reach 73, so until then an update published against this fingerprint reaches alpha testers only.

ios.$note: Built from main f6e882a2 (EAS build acaef141, workflow run 35983639391) and uploaded to TestFlight for the internal group 2026-09-24 (EAS submission 4dc6e12c; Apple's processing reports by email). First iOS binary with light mode (#202) and the light video host (patches/expo-video+55.0.21+004+ios-light-video-view.patch). The fingerprint equals a clean npm ci of f6e882a2, computed before the build. The App Store still serves 0.1.5 (54) at 835877cfddddf3644cf2e03bc8da01d7aec206d0 (released 2026-09-21) until 0.1.6 is approved, and no update from main can reach 54, so until then an update published against this fingerprint reaches TestFlight only.
